question: Does disabling the adopt-any-observed-key reconstruction (verbatim bind or correct-family-required rewriting only, no cross-family key adoption) restore discriminability of WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining vs hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation (xMemory episode->semantic component->theme, revisable grouping, top-down complementary selection) vs flat top-k RAG (k=5 cosine) on the same validated synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed multi-channel splits (40 pooled, 30 orthogonal, 10 mixed, 9 held-out) — measured by correct endpoint invocation vs template rewriting, coverage>=0.15 and evidence density, calibration ECE<=0.15 UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs without new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs?
hypothesis: Disabling the powerful adopt-any-observed-key reconstruction will restore discriminability that is currently masked (parent EXP-FRONTIER-35789949165: all pipelines 39/40 0.975 identical, coverage gain 0.0 CI [0,0] p=1.0 under adopt-any-key). Under a discriminating binding rule, retrieval/mining complementarity becomes identifiable: (a) VERBATIM manipulation check: alias-OOD correct collapses to ~0/40 for all pipelines (since held-out alias form not in registry, leak 0/40), confirming 39/40 was reconstruction artifact; (b) CORRECT-FAMILY-REQUIRED rewriting (allow adoption only when candidate's component family matches derived_context observed family; cross-family key adoption forbidden) restores ordering: hierarchical and/or WebAPI endpoint mining achieve coverage gain >=0.15 absolute over best flat top-5 RAG (TFIDF-K5 vs EMBED-K5) with block bootstrap 95% CI lower>0.05 p<0.05 and evidence density gain >0, while flat collapses under pool 8>k=5 truncation. WebAPI endpoint theme-diversified mining is predicted to be at least non-inferior to hierarchical and to show larger coverage gain on mixed multi-channel tasks where endpoint components span header+body+query+auth jointly. If instead coverage gain remains 0.0 under correct-family rule, retrieval diversity is not the bottleneck and endpoint mining does not provide orthogonal leverage for these families on minimal derived dict.
falsifier: Controls PASS required for any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-EXACT-MATCH fails (any pipeline exact correct <0.90 or false>0.10 on exact-match N=12), PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH fails (non-empty retrieval <90% on alias-OOD), PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT fails (<3 endpoint themes or <6 endpoint components or episode != registry size or forbidden keys), PC-VERBATIM-MANIPULATION-CHECK fails (verbatim alias-OOD not <=0.05 for all pipelines — indicates leakage or retained reconstruction), NC-NO-APPLICABLE fails (UNKNOWN precision<0.90 or false>0.10 on no-applicable N=12), NC-EMPTY fails (not 100% UNKNOWN on empty N=6), NC-ORACLE-LEAK fails (derived_context contains forbidden keys alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/expected_endpoint or indexer reads hidden_expected or confidence std<=0.05), pooled N<32, >20% harness errors, registry endpoint leak >0/40, or retrieval/endpoint discovery empty >50% on alias-OOD. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but manipulation check passes (verbatim collapses) and CORRECT-FAMILY primary fails: coverage gain for both hierarchical vs best flat and WebAPI vs best flat <0.05 absolute with bootstrap p>=0.05 and McNemar hierarchical vs best flat p>=0.05 and WebAPI vs best flat p>=0.05 and WebAPI vs hierarchical McNemar p>=0.05 (no ordering), or alias-OOD correct-family pooled <0.20 for all pipelines with no significant difference. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires controls pass, verbatim manipulation check passes, and at least one of hierarchical or WebAPI shows coverage gain >=0.15 with CI lower>0.05 vs best flat under correct-family rule (see decision_rule). MIXED if controls and manipulation check pass but coverage gain is intermediate (0.05-0.15) or only one pipeline shows gain without density gain.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (ID B-EXACT-MATCH): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. No retrieval diversity, no endpoint mining, verbatim bind. Prior 0/40 alias-OOD pooled, 12/12 exact. Calibrates aliasing break of exact matcher.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY): Scan registry in insertion order, retrieve top-1 by exact intent equality, replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without rewriting or endpoint discovery. Prior alias-OOD correct 0/40, false_accept 1.0 under adopt-any-key; under verbatim expected 0/40. Measures negative transfer.

B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5-VERBATIM (ID B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-VERBATIM): Flat TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; cosine top-k=5 then verbatim bind (no rewriting). Fit on train registry only. Tests lexical similarity under truncation with no reconstruction. Expected pooled alias-OOD 0/40 verbatim.

B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5-VERBATIM (ID B-FLAT-EMBED-K5-VERBATIM): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline, normalized) over intent+template; top-k=5 cosine then verbatim bind. If offline model unavailable, mark unavailable and use TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals. Expected pooled 0/40 verbatim.
B-RANDOM-K5-VERBATIM (ID B-RANDOM-K5-VERBATIM): Uniform random among registry mechanisms sample k=5 distinct then verbatim bind. Chance-level retrieval diversity baseline verbatim.

B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5-CORRECTFAMILY (ID B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF): Same TFIDF top-5 retriever but binding via correct-family-required rewriting (allow adoption of observed key only if candidate's component family matches derived_context observed family; cross-family adoption forbidden) before _bind, conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates). Tests whether flat retrieval can benefit from restricted rewrite.
B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5-CORRECTFAMILY (ID B-FLAT-EMBED-K5-CF): Same embed top-5 retriever with correct-family-required rewriting. Strong flat baseline for primary comparison.
B-RANDOM-K5-CORRECTFAMILY (ID B-RANDOM-K5-CF): Random k=5 with correct-family-required rewriting. Chance-level with restricted rewrite.

H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY-VERBATIM (ID H-HIERARCHICAL-VERBATIM): Decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval from EXP-FRONTIER-35782552659 (Level1 episodes=mechanisms, Level2 components via template parsing, Level3 themes via Jaccard>=0.6 agglomerative, theme centroids TFIDF/embed, top-down complementary selection entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2, adaptive k 2-5) then verbatim bind. Reuses byte-identical code run_genuine_35782552659.py sha 2d66408199cebeb96627dee91f694a9b46e1e0e8c0d3396a80089f284ad82c83 to isolate reconstruction delta. Expected pooled 0/40 verbatim.

H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY-CORRECTFAMILY (ID H-HIERARCHICAL-CF): Same hierarchical retrieval but binding via correct-family-required rewriting. Primary comparator for hierarchical complementarity under discriminating rule. ID H-HIERARCHICAL-CF.

H-WEBAPI-ENDPOINT-MINING-VERBATIM (ID H-WEBAPI-VERBATIM): WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining pipeline. Endpoint catalog derived from training registry endpoint specs (path template + method + auth-scope) via same template parsing as hierarchical but endpoint-indexed: Level1 endpoints, Level2 endpoint components {path_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes}, Level3 endpoint themes via Jaccard>=0.6 clustering on endpoint component sets. Query-time endpoint discovery: score endpoint themes by cosine/lexical relevance between derived_context (intent+url_path+query_keys+header_keys+body_keys+method) and theme centroid, select themes top-down complementarily (entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2), sample k=3-5 endpoint candidates complementarily across themes, then verbatim endpoint binding (no rewriting). All endpoint indexing fit on train registry only. Expected pooled 0/40 verbatim.

H-WEBAPI-ENDPOINT-MINING-CORRECTFAMILY (ID H-WEBAPI-CF): Same WebAPI endpoint mining but endpoint invocation via correct-family-required rewriting (endpoint_choose_adoptions_correct_family: allow binding of derived_context value into endpoint template slot only when slot family matches observed family; cross-family endpoint adoption forbidden) before _bind+verify. Primary experimental pipeline for WebAPI under discriminating rule. ID H-WEBAPI-CF.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULES (reference): Two frozen binding rules held constant across retrieval/mining conditions to isolate discovery effect: RULE-VERBATIM (no rewriting, direct _bind, UNKNOWN if slots missing) and RULE-CORRECTFAMILY (adopt-observed-key only if candidate component family overlaps derived_context family; alphabetically-sorted single-adoption per family, no cross-family). Prior powerful RULE-ADOPTANY (choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi any key not in registry) used in parent 39/40 is explicitly disabled in this experiment; parent result is baseline for contamination magnitude.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH (ID PC-EXACT-MATCH): On exact-match stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions={}, guards={}), every pipeline under both VERBATIM and CORRECTFAMILY rules must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline does not regress when no aliasing required and correct-family rule does not mis-route exact matches (exact candidates already match family). Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH (ID PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH): For alias-OOD pooled N=40, all retrievers/mining (flat TFIDF, flat EMBED, hierarchical, WebAPI) must return non-empty candidate sets on >=90% of tasks under both rules and hierarchical/WebAPI distinct-component coverage >= flat distinct-component coverage on at least 50% of tasks under correct-family rule. If <90% non-empty, substrate invalid -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT (ID PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT): WebAPI endpoint index must contain >=3 endpoint themes and >=6 endpoint components and episode/endpoint count equals registry size (train registry size per family, e.g., 8*4 intents for task group) with no hidden_expected leakage, audited via index manifest hash; hierarchical index health also checked (>=3 themes >=6 components) if hierarchical comparator run. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-VERBATIM-MANIPULATION-CHECK (ID PC-VERBATIM-CHECK): Under VERBATIM rule, pooled alias-OOD correct must be <=0.05 (0-2/40) for ALL pipelines (including hierarchical and WebAPI) with Wilson CI upper <=0.15, confirming powerful reconstruction was necessary for parent 39/40 and that test forms are truly held-out (leak 0/40). If any pipeline >0.05 verbatim, indicates leakage or retained rewriting -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-ENDPOINT-DISCOVERY-SANITY (ID PC-ENDPOINT-DISCOVERY-SANITY, exploratory not gating SURVIVES except via PC-EXACT-MATCH): On exact-match 12 under correct-family rule, WebAPI endpoint invocation must select correct endpoint method+path+auth-scope with accuracy >=0.90.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE (ID NC-NO-APPLICABLE): On no-applicable stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism/endpoint) every pipeline under both rules must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY (ID NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY): Empty registry / empty endpoint catalog (N=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% for all pipelines under both rules (validates neither hierarchical nor WebAPI hallucinate themes/endpoints when correct-family rule is applied). NC-ORACLE-LEAK (ID NC-ORACLE-LEAK): Audit that derived_context contains only allowed keys (url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed) and both hierarchical component extraction and WebAPI endpoint component extraction use only template string parsing (no access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/expected_endpoint) and no hard-coded confidence (std>0.05, varies across tasks, gated). Also audit that correct-family rule does not read hidden_expected_family but derives family from template parsing and derived_context observed key types only. Failure of any NC -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-FLAT-COLLAPSE-DIAGNOSTIC (exploratory, not gating): Flat TFIDF/embed top-5 Jaccard overlap among retrieved templates >0.80 on alias-OOD 40 when pool 8 > k=5 under correct-family rule documents similarity collapse when hierarchical/WebAPI selection not used; reported but not gating.
measurement_validity: Registry and fixture reuse for comparability with discriminability fix: Reuse task intents/expected templates from byte-identical synthetic fixture EXP-FRONTIER-35773143736 tasks.json sha 4abf1487 (40 alias-OOD pooled =30 orthogonal 3 families x10 [7 standard +3 held-out] +10 mixed header+body+query co-occurring, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks) but expand per-task registry/candidate pool from parent 3 to 8 mechanisms per alias-OOD task to make retrieval complementarity identifiable: per alias-OOD task registry now contains 1 training mechanism (correct alias family at 0.9) + 7 distractors (2 same-family different alias form at 0.9, 2 cross-family header/body/auth at 0.9, 2 mixed-channel fragments at 0.85, 1 low-confidence random at 0.8) all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing; test query uses held-out alias form with same semantic intent string as training (intent held equal -> exact matcher failure). Verify 0/40 leakage (no test template/endpoint verbatim in registry/catalog) and 0/9 held-out 0/10 mixed. This preserves task semantics while fixing parent structural pool<=k (coverage 1.0 for all) limitation. No new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs required per Director rationale (avoids 0/4 envs substrate failure seen in 12 prior live attempts, Scout predicted). Holdout integrity preserved: 9 held-out forms (X-Api-Key/X-Auth-Key/Api-Token/api_token/authToken/access_key/permission/access_scope/X-Scope) not in indexer training, mixed 10 compositions held-out from clustering training (cluster fit on train registry only).

State and component representation - genuine non-oracle with correct-family gating: derived_context provided to retriever/mining and to rewriting contains ONLY observation-derived fields from synthetic URL/header/body dict (url, method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments list, headers_observed dict, body_observed JSON/string). It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template, expected_endpoint. Hierarchical component extraction parses each mechanism template string to extract url_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes via deterministic template parsing (regex \$\{[^}]+\} slots + splitting on '/' '?' '&' ':'), never reading hidden_expected. WebAPI endpoint component extraction parses each endpoint spec (method + path template + auth template) similarly. Themes formed by clustering component sets (Jaccard>=0.6) and majority vote on component type. Retrieval/mining scoring uses only derived_context+intent vs theme centroid (TFIDF/embed), not hidden_expected. Correct-family-required rewriting derives eligibility solely from template-parsed candidate family vs derived_context observed key type family overlap, never from hidden_expected_family. Audit verifies no forbidden key reads via code inspection and index manifest contains only allowed parsed components; confidence varies std>0.05.

Action and endpoint representation and pipeline isolation with ablated binding: Mechanism action_template is string template with ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value, body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Endpoint spec is tuple (method, path_template, header_template, body_template, auth_scope) with same slot syntax. Two binding rules are frozen and applied identically after each retriever/mining to isolate discovery effect: RULE-VERBATIM (no rewriting, direct kernel _bind; fails if required slot missing -> false_accept/UNKNOWN) and RULE-CORRECTFAMILY (choose_adoptions_correct_family: for each candidate, compute candidate_families = {header, body, auth, path, query} present as slot types via template parsing; compute observed_families = {header if headers_observed non-empty aliased key, body if body_observed non-empty, auth if auth scope observed, query if url_query non-empty, path if url_segments contains alias token}; candidate eligible only if intersection non-empty; if eligible, rewrite only the overlapping family slots with observed values sorted alphabetically, cross-family slots left unfilled -> bind fails if still missing; otherwise candidate skipped). Confidence for both rules = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 for ECE. This ensures any correct_resolution improvement of hierarchical/WebAPI over flat under correct-family rule is attributable to endpoint discovery complementarity (retrieving correct family) not to stronger rewriting, since rewriting is held constant and forbidden to invent cross-family keys. Harness exposes hierarchical_retrieve(intent, derived_context, registry) -> candidates, flat_retrieve same, webapi_mine(intent, derived_context, endpoint_catalog) -> endpoint_candidates, and two bind wrappers for audit.

Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks =3 families x10: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing, held-out X-Api-Key), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs token, held-out api_token/authToken/access_key), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header, held-out permission/access_scope/X-Scope). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (e.g., header X-Api-Key + body api_token + query permission simultaneously aliased), registry training mechanisms are single-channel only; test requires joint multi-field rewriting/invocation conditioned on derived_context containing all three observed keys and retrieving/discovering complementary candidates whose families jointly cover all channels. Hierarchical themes predicted to retrieve one header-theme + one body-theme + one auth-theme candidate vs flat top-5 retrieving homogeneous near-duplicates when pool 8 > k=5; WebAPI endpoint themes predicted to discover complementary endpoint candidates across header/body/auth themes. No AX tree or BrowserGym required; task count 40 pooled primary, 30 orthogonal and 10 mixed diagnostics, held-out 9 diagnostic.

Indexing protocol (deterministic, revisable): Level1 episodes/endpoints indexed as mechanism/endpoint documents (intent+template/endpoint text). Level2 components extracted as sets {header:ApiKey, body:apiKey, ...} per mechanism/endpoint. Level3 themes via agglomerative clustering with Jaccard threshold 0.6 on component sets, revisable by re-clustering if new mechanism added (disclosed but not exercised). Theme centroid computed as mean TFIDF vector or mean embed (MiniLM) of member documents. Query-time: score themes by cosine between query (intent+derived_context serialized as 'intent url_path query_keys header_keys body_keys method') and theme centroid; rank themes; select themes top-down: start with best theme, expand to next theme only when current selected set uncertainty reduction criterion met: entropy of softmax over current candidate scores >0.4 or distinct component coverage <2 on alias-OOD families. Adaptive k = 3-5 candidates sampled complementarily (at least one per selected theme, max 2 per theme). Flat baselines use global top-5 cosine over episodes (no theme diversity). All retrievers/mining deterministic given seed 42. WebAPI mining uses identical top-down complementary selection at endpoint-theme level.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42); deterministic hashing via hashlib.sha256, not Python hash(). TFIDF vectorizer and embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Clustering deterministic (scipy or sklearn with fixed seed). Each task evaluated once per pipeline per rule (paired design); block bootstrap resampling for CIs uses 2000 resamples over tasks grouped by trajectory (here task family header/body/auth/mixed, so trajectory-grouped bootstrap respects family structure).

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 leakage for pooled, 0/9 for held-out, 0/10 mixed). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry/catalog only (registry/catalog built from training mechanisms/endpoints). Hierarchical and WebAPI theme centroids fit on train registry/catalog only. Both rewriting rules derived from observed key family matching only (no hidden_expected). Correct-family rule eligibility audit verifies no cross-family adoption (candidate family vs observed family intersection check). No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating, substrate-available): Alias-OOD 40 pooled (30 orthogonal +10 mixed) is primary (minimum 32 if mixed partially unavailable with disclosure, but 40 required for beta=0.8 power to detect 0.45 vs 0.10 at n=40 with binomial). Exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 per pipeline per rule. Pipelines: 4 flat verbatim + 4 flat correctfamily + 2 hierarchical verbatim/correctfamily + 2 WebAPI verbatim/correctfamily + 2 exact/verbatim baselines =14 pipeline-rule combos =70*14=980 calls max. Hierarchical and WebAPI indexing is offline (<2 min CPU each for TFIDF/embed centroid + agglomerative clustering). No live BrowserGym tasks required; cost is CPU-only. All pipelines evaluated paired per task enabling McNemar. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power; mixed diagnostic requires N>=10 else downgraded. Registry expansion to 8 per task is valid for complementarity identifiability; pool saturation check (pool>k) reported. Verbatim manipulation check N=40 pooled required.

Verification, metrics, and retrieval complementarity under ablated binding: correct_resolution for template pipelines under RULE-VERBATIM = retrieved set contains verbatim-correct template and bind yields expected_bound (header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct) — expected 0/40 for alias-OOD; under RULE-CORRECTFAMILY = retrieved set contains candidate whose family matches observed family and after correct-family-restricted rewrite, bind yields expected_bound (including header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct). correct_endpoint_invocation for WebAPI analogously under each rule. false_accept = resolved/invoked to wrong template/endpoint or bound incorrectly or should have abstained. UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism/endpoint or gated confidence<0.80. Retrieval recall@k per task under correct-family rule = 1 if candidate set contains at least one mechanism/endpoint whose template after correct-family-restricted rewriting yields correct bound, else 0. Coverage = mean recall@k over pooled. Coverage gain = hierarchical/WebAPI coverage - best flat coverage (max of TFIDF-K5-CF and EMBED-K5-CF) under correct-family rule. Evidence density = mean distinct semantic/endpoint components (distinct header_keys+body_fields+auth_scopes/path segments) in candidate set divided by k, averaged over alias-OOD under correct-family rule. Evidence density gain = WebAPI/hierarchical density - flat density. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (candidate-relevance-derived confidence) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for hierarchical/WebAPI vs B-EXACT-MATCH and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY and WebAPI vs hierarchical and vs best flat (all under correct-family rule for primary); block bootstrap 2000 for coverage/density gains and ECE CI, trajectory-grouped by family. Report per-family, held-out-9, mixed-10 breakdowns and adaptive k distribution. Primary leverage comparison is WebAPI-CF vs hierarchical-CF vs best flat-CF on same 40 pooled splits under correct-family rule; verbatim results reported as manipulation check.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: No pipeline tuned on test alias forms nor mixed compositions; held-out and mixed excluded from theme/endpoint centroid training and clustering. Derived_context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before retrieve/mine call. Component and endpoint extraction parses only template strings, not hidden_expected metadata. Confidence derivation inspectable (softmax scores visible). Correct-family rule does not memorize mixed template/endpoint but composes via family-matched adoption verified by cross-family audit (check that header test never solved by body-only candidate). No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on pooled alias-OOD (N=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) under RULE-CORRECTFAMILY unless stated as verbatim manipulation check; use Wilson 95% CI, one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null, paired McNemar, block bootstrap 2000 (trajectory-grouped by family). Computations per-pipeline correct (correct_resolution for template pipelines, correct_endpoint_invocation for WebAPI), false_accept, UNKNOWN, coverage, density, ECE over 5 confidence bins (derived confidence) with bootstrap CI. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (discriminability restored — endpoint vs hierarchical vs flat ordering identifiable) iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (all pipelines correct>=0.90 and false<=0.10 on exact-match N=12 under both rules; WebAPI-CF and hierarchical-CF exact >=0.90 and not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH) and PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH passes (non-empty >=90% for all retrievers/mining and WebAPI-CF distinct coverage >= flat-CF on >=50%) and PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT passes (>=3 endpoint themes >=6 endpoint components episode==registry size no leak, hierarchical themes also >=3 if checked) and PC-VERBATIM-CHECK passes (verbatim pooled alias-OOD correct <=0.05 for all pipelines, confirming 39/40 was reconstruction artifact); (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision>=0.90 false<=0.10 for all under both rules) AND NC-EMPTY 100% AND NC-ORACLE-LEAK passes (no forbidden reads, std>0.05); (3) Under RULE-CORRECTFAMILY, pooled alias-OOD S1: at least one of H-HIERARCHICAL-CF or H-WEBAPI-CF achieves pooled correct >=0.30 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (0/40 expected) — threshold 0.30 not 0.50 because correct-family restriction makes task harder than adopt-any-key; report orthogonal >=0.25 and mixed >=0.25 diagnostic and held-out 9/9 >=0.25 diagnostic; (4) S2: that surviving pipeline's false_accept <=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY-CF by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept; (5) S3: that pipeline's exact-match correct >=0.90 (no regression, not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH); (6) S4: that pipeline's no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 AND ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) with bootstrap CI upper <=0.18 under correct-family rule; (7) S5 not dominated: that pipeline's pooled correct-family correct not >0.10 below best flat-CF pooled correct; if both flat-CF are 0/40, any >0 is not dominated; (8) S6 COMPLEMENTARITY (primary): that pipeline's coverage gain >=0.15 absolute over best flat-CF (max of TFIDF-K5-CF and EMBED-K5-CF) with block bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.05 and p<0.05, AND evidence density gain >0 with bootstrap p<0.05. For WebAPI to claim higher-leverage than hierarchical, WebAPI-CF coverage gain must be >= hierarchical-CF coverage gain and WebAPI-CF vs hierarchical-CF McNemar correct-family p<0.05 if WebAPI > hierarchical, or at parity WebAPI must show larger density gain. If hierarchical restores discriminability but WebAPI does not (hierarchical gain >=0.15 WebAPI gain <0.05), decision is HIERARCHICAL-SURVIVES (not WebAPI). If both show gain >=0.15, ordering is WebAPI vs hierarchical McNemar determines higher-leverage. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls and verbatim check pass but under correct-family rule S1 fails (all pipelines pooled correct-family <0.20 or binomial p>=0.05) or S6 fails for both hierarchical-CF and WebAPI-CF (coverage gain <0.05 non-significant, p>=0.05 and McNemar vs best flat p>=0.05) — bounded to synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits with minimal derived dict under correct-family-required binding, not global falsification of semantic resolution. MIXED if controls and verbatim check pass and S1-S5 pass for at least one pipeline but S6 coverage gain is 0.05-0.15 (marginal) or density gain NS, or verbatim check passes but correct-family gain is significant only for one of hierarchical/WebAPI without the other. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC or NC fails, or verbatim manipulation check fails (>0.05 indicating leakage/retained cross-family rewrite), or audit detects oracle leak (forbidden key access or hardcoded confidence std<=0.05 or cross-family adoption not actually forbidden) or pooled alias-OOD N<32 or >20% harness errors or registry/endpoint leak >0/40 or retrieval/endpoint discovery empty >50% on alias-OOD.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES with S1-S6 including coverage gain >=0.15 and density gain under correct-family-required rule for WebAPI-CF (and verbatim manipulation check confirms 39/40 was artifact): Disabling adopt-any-observed-key reconstruction restores discriminability — WebAPI endpoint+method+auth-scope mining (tool/API bypass via direct endpoint discovery) provides measurable higher-leverage alias-OOD resolution than hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation retrieval complementarity and flat top-k RAG on validated orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits without BrowserGym, when binding is restricted to correct-family adoption. Product should prioritize discriminating retrieval/mining evaluation with correct-family gating before template rewriting: endpoint catalog mining via endpoint component clustering (path/query/header/body/auth), endpoint theme centroids (header/body/auth/mixed) via Jaccard 0.6, top-down complementary selection expanding only when uncertainty reduces (entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2), adaptive k 3-5 maximizing distinct endpoint coverage, then deterministic endpoint invocation with correct-family-restricted rewriting and confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80 and ECE<=0.15 and verification boundary. This validates that prior 39/40 tie was reconstruction contamination and that endpoint discovery is genuinely higher-leverage than retrieval diversity for header/body/auth aliasing when reconstruction cannot invent cross-family keys. It addresses BrowserUse 99% script caching (exact replay) vs alias-OOD distinction and Stagehand 2x/30% DOM-hash baseline by showing endpoint bypass beats flat RAG only when reconstruction is calibrated.
